recommended_next_phase: 149O.20L.7O.2K -- HATP Prerequisite DAG Correction and Next Real-Effect Node Selection (HMIC Certification vs. Hardware-Credential Enrollment). Analysis-only: formally amend the carried-forward DAG record to reflect 2J's correction, then choose and author its own narrow authorization envelope for whichever of HMIC CertificationRecord creation or FIDO2 hardware-credential enrollment is selected as the actual next real-effect step.
summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.2J is an authorization/planning-only phase that independently re-derived Protected Root's exact resolution path and full HBDC-REQ-011..021 requirement set directly from HBDC-001 v1.2 and production source, rather than from 149O.20L.7O.2I's prose. It discovered, from primary evidence already committed to this repository (149O.20L.7E/7N.5/7O.2A.5/7O.2B.1, dated 2026-08-15 through 2026-08-18, all real/unmocked/read-only), that 149O.20L.7O.2I's central claim -- Protected Root existence on hac-dell is ABSENT -- is false: Protected Root already exists at root:pcae mode 750, ACL confirmed with no extra grants, not a symlink, with fully safe root:root 755 ancestors, and already independently satisfies HBDC-REQ-011 through HBDC-REQ-018 in full. The sole residual Class-B conformance failure on the most recent real measurement (149O.20L.7O.2B.1, 2026-08-18) is HBDC-REQ-042 (no_active_deployment_binding_matches_repository_and_root), a RepositoryIdentity/DeploymentBinding gap unrelated to Protected Root. Because Protected Root requires no creation, this phase issued no creation authorization; instead it froze a narrow read-only re-verification envelope (an exact stat/getfacl/find precheck set with an explicit pass/fail/existing-path-state matrix) for any future real-effect phase that relies on Protected Root's state, and corrected 149O.20L.7O.2I's prerequisite DAG: HATP activation and Class-B provisioning topology work did not occur this phase and are not what changed -- the true first unmet DAG node is now either HMIC CertificationRecord creation or hardware-credential (FIDO2) enrollment, with the choice deferred to the next phase. 11-test focused evidence suite passed. Fast_green raw comparison against a git-stash baseline was identical (327 failed/12 errors both with and without this phase's changes; the only delta was the 11 new passing tests), so zero attributable regressions were introduced. HMIC-001 v1.6 (36/7) and HBDC-001 v1.2 remain byte-unchanged.
